name: CLAVIS-M_c1
description: CLAVIS with a test-time visual OOD memory (vins/clavism.py). Admission p_all <= eps_admit (d over ALL ID classes), g = d - (r_M - med_all)/mad_all with r_M the m_mem-th NN cosine distance to the memory, per-batch conformal p_t, score S_final * p_t.

selection.rule: simplest setting (m_mem = m = 2, eps 10%, diff) whose dev1 far AUROC is not below CLAVIS; not the dev1 argmax
